item.text:
## Birch Harbor support invoices: January–March 2025

| Service month | Invoice or record | Amount |
|---|---|---:|
| January 2025 | Invoice 25-01 | $100 |
| February 2025 | February work was cancelled before service; no charge was issued | $0 |
| March 2025 | Invoice 25-03 | $120 |

**Total for the quarter: $220**, based on the two 2025 invoices found. The agreement says support is ordered only when needed, with no monthly minimum, which supports not imputing a February charge.

Sources: [January invoice](current/jan.txt), [March invoice](current/mar.txt), [support agreement](current/agreement.txt), and [February cancellation email](other/scheduling.txt).

The February cancellation record is not an invoice; the report treats it as confirmation that no February charge belongs in the total. The separate [old February invoice](other/old-feb.txt) is for February 2024 ($190), so it does not establish a 2025 charge. **Decision needed:** confirm that this quarter’s total should include only 2025 charges and exclude that 2024 invoice.
